evals.name: adv-funnel
evals.prompt: Design a complete lead funnel for a local reseller who flips furniture on Facebook Marketplace: lead magnet, landing page, thank-you page, sales page and follow-up, plus list math.
assertions: Covers all five parts: lead magnet, landing page, thank-you page, sales page, follow-up
Lead magnet uses a curiosity/pain hook (e.g. 'The # Biggest Mistakes...')
Includes a thank-you-page offer or self-liquidating offer
Includes list math (e.g. $1 per name per month) with an estimate
Includes a follow-up sequence or daily publishing plan

evals.name: adv-economics
evals.prompt: My ad costs $2 per lead. I want to break even on day one. Using the Lead Funnels Swipe File, explain self-liquidating offers, break-even day and RFMS, and design the numbers.
assertions: Explains RFMS scoring (recency, frequency, monetary, source)
Does concrete math on $2/lead with a conversion rate and price
Suggests a fast info product to sell (one of the nine fast ways)
